title: 15 Years of Waiting, My Fiancé Returns Pretending to Be Poor
description: A Chinese microdrama (15年青春苦守，未婚夫装穷归来) built on a staple revenge-romance setup: a long-waiting fiancée and a fiancé who comes back disguised as poor before the truth comes out.
descriptionMore: We weren't able to independently verify this title's production details or exact plot beyond its title and the viewing figures supplied — around 2.37 billion views as of September 2026, by far the largest of the titles added here.
